title: EE60108: Adaptive And Array Signal Processing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Overview, Objective and Contents:Overview: Sensors Array and Adaptive Signal
Processing is an emerging discipline thathas been defined as the study,
invention and implementation of structures and algorithmsto improve the
communication, understanding and management of information in theform of
digital signal in the sensor networks. This paradigm emphasizes on
theintegration of data, knowledge, and tools necessary for efficient knowledge
discovery inthe decision-making process associated with information extraction
and computationalintelligence. It can be found at the heart of many electronic
signal processing systemsdesigned to extract information. These systems include
Radar, Sonar, Speech, ImageAnalysis, Biomedicine, Control, Communications and
Seismology. It is therefore animportant goal to develop this subject addressing
the requirements and to train thestudents in understanding the above-specified
applications for development of efficientdecision-making system having better
signal handling capabilities.Objective:• To develop an in-depth understanding
with the basic theoretical knowledge andpractical experience from the area of
embedded systems.• To know the various statistical techniques for processing
and visualization of digitalinformation on the MATLAB.Contents:Course Content
LectureAdaptive Systems and adaptive linear combiner, input signals and
weightvectors, Performance function, MMSE -- 3 hourMethod of Steepest Descent
and LMS adaptive filters, Stability andRobustness of LMS filter, Normalised LMS
filter, Tracking performance. -- 6 hourMVDR spectrum estimation Recursive least
square adaptive filters, SquareRootAdaptive filters,QR-RLS algorithm, Tracking
performance -- 6 hourIIR Adaptive filters: Output Error method and Equation
error methodBlind Deconvolution, Bussgang Algorithm --5 hourApplications:
Adaptive modeling in FIR digital Filter Synthesis, Adaptivemodeling of a
multipath communication channel and Adaptive interferencecancellation -- 5
hourSensor Array Processing:Array Fundamentals, Conventional Spatial Filtering,
BeamformerClassification, Data Independent Beamforming, Optimum
BeamformingMultiplesidelobe canceller, SNR maximization -- 6 hourDirection-ofarrival estimation: Subspace-based methods-Signal and Noisesubspace methods:
Search-based method, Algebraic method (MinimumVariance, AR, Subspace fitting,
MUSIC) --5 hourArray processing for mobile communications: Vector channel
models,Performance consideration: Effect of Signal Mismatch, Bandwidth,
Correlatedarrivals, MMSE beamformer, Peak-to-Average power ratio reduction,
Analysisof adaptive Beamformer8 hourConclusions, Feedback, Expectations
1Recommended Text Books/Reference Books:Adaptive Filter Theory By Simon Haykin,
W. C. Stirling, ISBN-13: 81-7808-565-8, PearsonEducation, 2005.Adaptive Signal
Processing by B. Widrow and S. D. Stearns, ISBN 978-81-317-0532-2,Dorling
Kindersley (India) Pvt. Ltd. 2009Statistical and Adaptive Signal Processing: By
D. G. Manolakis and V. K. Ingle and S. M.Kogan, Artech House ISBN: 1-58053-6107.
